_description: Image prompt templates for each LinkedIn post type. Used by the dispatch engine to generate hero images via FLUX.1/Imagen 3.

project.note: Project posts use real UI screenshots + architecture specs as a PDF carousel. No AI-generated hero needed — the product IS the visual.

daily-build.prompt_template: A dramatic cinematic 3D render of a software engineer's workspace at {time_of_day}. On a dark ultrawide monitor, glowing {color} code and terminal output show {visual_metaphor}. The scene has volumetric lighting, lens flare, and a cyberpunk aesthetic. Dark background (#030712), 8k resolution, professional photography, shallow depth of field. No text overlays.

visual_metaphor: a distributed system topology healing itself

trend.prompt_template: A futuristic 3D infographic visualization floating in dark space (#030712). The central element is a {shape} made of glowing {color} neon wireframe, representing {topic_metaphor}. Small data particles and holographic HUD elements orbit around it. Clean, modern, minimalist tech aesthetic. 8k resolution, no text, pure visual impact.

topic_metaphor: the convergence of AI and infrastructure
the shift from cloud to edge

lesson.prompt_template: A clean, modern 3D render of {scene}. The aesthetic is premium tech photography with soft ambient lighting, dark background (#030712), and subtle {accent_color} accent glow. Professional, contemplative mood. 8k resolution, cinematic composition, no text overlays.

scene: an architect's blueprint being refined with holographic annotations
a whiteboard covered in system design diagrams being illuminated by a spotlight
a single perfectly engineered component floating in space, glowing from within
a split-screen showing chaos on one side and elegant simplicity on the other

reflection.prompt_template: A contemplative, atmospheric 3D scene of {setting}. {detail}. Warm and cool tones blended together, volumetric fog, golden hour lighting mixed with cool blue tech glow. Dark background (#030712). Cinematic, personal, authentic mood. 8k resolution, professional photography.

setting: a developer looking out a window at a city skyline, laptop open on the desk behind them
a quiet workspace with multiple screens showing a completed project dashboard
a pair of hands sketching architecture diagrams on paper, surrounded by tech devices
a coffee cup next to an open laptop showing a finished deployment log
detail: The screen reflects in the window glass
Ambient desk LEDs cast a soft glow
Scattered sticky notes tell a story of iteration
The dawn light is just starting to break through
